title: Camera-based Endoscopy Allows Spontaneous Breathing Diagnostic Management in Neonates With Tracheoesophageal Fistula
official: Camera-based Endoscopy Allows Spontaneous Breathing Diagnostic Management in Neonates With Tracheoesophageal Fistula
summary: The investigators aim to compare rigid tracheoscopy versus flexible tracheo-video-endoscopy in neonates requiring diagnostic assessment before undergoing a congenital tracheoesophageal fistula repair.

interventions.name: tracheoscopy performed with rigid optical tracheoscopy

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Neonates who have undergone surgical repair of esophageal atresia with or without tracheoesophageal fistula at ASST Papa Giovanni XXIII, Bergamo, from 1 January 2013 onwards
* Written informed consent signed by both parents or legal guardian

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal or inability to obtain informed consent from parents or legal guardian
